banner.title: headlamp
banner.tagline: Cluster dashboard for Kubernetes and Flux objects, behind Authentik on the internal gateway only.

art.about: a cluster dashboard behind single sign-on and an internal gateway
art.title: How Headlamp reaches the cluster

explainer.title: Browser to cluster API, through Authentik and a plugin volume

steps.title: Gate
steps.text: Envoy asks Authentik to approve each request through the headlamp-auth SecurityPolicy before the route forwards it.
steps.scene: a padlock on a gateway arch

steps.title: Route
steps.text: One HTTPRoute serves the dashboard on envoy-internal only, with no public DNS record.
steps.scene: a path on a map leading into a dashboard

steps.title: Plugin
steps.text: An init container copies the Flux plugin onto a 1 GiB Ceph volume. The UI container mounts it read-only.
steps.scene: a puzzle piece sliding into a slot

steps.title: Act
steps.text: The pod runs as the headlamp-admin ServiceAccount, which holds a cluster-admin binding.
steps.scene: a cluster-admin key glowing above a server rack

steps.title: Restart
steps.text: The Recreate strategy stops the old pod before the new one starts, so the single-attach volume detaches cleanly.
steps.scene: one pod fading before the next lights up
